name: 26164 · Ravenswood, WV
findings: ZIP 26164 (Ravenswood) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26164 (Ravenswood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 26164 (Ravenswood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
